title: engagement.yaml

organization.description: Legal name of the audited organization, as printed

scope.description: The scope statement as the report prints it, in one sentence (ISMS scope, processing in scope, services in scope)

auditor.description: Always "AI Audit". The signing model is signoff.model.

audit_type.description: One of the audit types in the skill's assets/profile.yaml (ISO: stage1, stage2, surveillance, recertification; GDPR and NIS2: assessment, audit)

period.description: Records period sampled (audit types without as_of in the profile)

as_of.description: Date of the documentation review (point-in-time audit types)

management.description: The organization's representative named in the report. Real values from the evidence, never a placeholder.

language.description: Language of the report and of the requirement text in it. Workpapers, findings and the organization's responses must be written in this language too.

signoff.description: Written only by `signoff --model`. The model that ran the AI Audit.

roles.description: GDPR: the organization's roles in scope (controller, processor)

entity_types.description: NIS2: essential or important, plus digital-providers when the Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690 applies

include_optional.description: Optional requirements audited anyway (GDPR Art.40 to Art.43 when the organization relies on a code of conduct or certification)

description: engagement.yaml for the requirements engine; audit_type and period/as_of are checked against the skill's profile by core.py
